tagline: Managing Ireland's debt and investing in economic development
hero_kpi_rationale: The average funding cost reflects Ireland's access to sovereign markets, a key factor in its post-crisis financial stability

kpis.name: Weighted Average Funding Yield
kpis.explanation: Average interest rate paid on issued long-term debt.
kpis.description: In 2014, the NTMA raised €11.75 billion at a weighted average yield of 2.8%, signaling a gradual return to markets.
kpis.signal: Very low financing cost in 2014 despite the crisis.

kpis.name: ISIF Assets Available for Investment
kpis.explanation: Value of assets managed by the Irish strategic fund to stimulate the economy.
kpis.description: Launched in December 2014, the ISIF succeeded the NPRF with €7.2 billion in assets available for investment in Ireland.
kpis.signal: ISIF launch with €7.2 billion in 2014 to boost employment.

kpis.name: Value of Infrastructure Projects Advised by NDFA
kpis.explanation: Total value of public projects advised by the NDFA.
kpis.description: By end-2014, the NDFA was advising on 20 infrastructure projects with a cumulative value of €3.5 billion.
kpis.signal: Significant pipeline of ongoing infrastructure projects.

kpis.name: Capital Under NewERA Supervision
kpis.explanation: Total value of capital in state-owned enterprises supervised by NewERA.
kpis.description: NewERA supervises €13.6 billion in capital across key sectors such as energy and telecommunications.
kpis.signal: Strategic oversight of €13.6 billion in public capital.

kpis.name: Value of Financial Proposals Analyzed by NewERA
kpis.explanation: Amount of financial proposals reviewed by NewERA for the government.
kpis.description: In 2014, NewERA analyzed €2.6 billion in financing proposals on behalf of government ministers.
kpis.signal: Central role in assessing public investment decisions.

kpis.name: Savings Achieved on Third-Party Legal Costs
kpis.explanation: Amount saved by the agency on external legal fees.
kpis.description: The SCA negotiated €9.9 million in savings on €19.3 million in legal fees related to the Mahon, Moriarty, and Smithwick tribunals.
kpis.signal: Effective reduction of inquiry tribunal-related costs.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €4.07 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.12 billion in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on relationships with IDA and Enterprise Ireland
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the section on ISIF's new functions, with language emphasizing the need for coordination. Central position in the document, strong language of importance ('critical', 'align strategies'), increasing trend with ISIF mandate expansion, relevant category is Competition due to linkage with investment opportunities.

risks.title: Reduction of autonomy with the dissolution of committees
risks.score_rationale: Several committees (Advisory Committee, State Claims Agency Policy Committee) were dissolved in 2014, indicating institutional consolidation. Neutral but structural language, stable trend since 2014, moderate weight as it relates to internal governance.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of the NIMS system
risks.score_rationale: The NIMS system is described as critical for risk management across the public service. Strong language ('critical', 'end-to-end'), high prominence in the text, increasing trend with deployment, highly sensitive category.

risks.title: Dependence on NTMA's internal expertise
risks.score_rationale: The report repeatedly highlights employee expertise and dedication as a key asset. Valuing language ('struck by the expertise', 'critical role'), increasing trend following John Corrigan's departure, high weight due to operational continuity.

risks.title: Extension of SCA mandate to 129 public entities
risks.score_rationale: The State Claims Agency's expanded mandate is documented with precise figures. Factual but complexity-implicating language, increasing trend, Industrial category due to operational linkage.

risks.title: Transfer of NPRF assets to ISIF and dissolution
risks.score_rationale: The transfer of NPRF assets to ISIF and the dissolution of NPRF represent major structural changes. Transformational language ('transfer', 'dissolved'), increasing trend, high weight due to capital structure impact.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2014 annual report.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation tools.
Mentioned systems (such as NIMS) are conventional risk management tools.
No AI-related investment or project is reported.
